q: 爷爷看报纸的时候要___老花镜。
zh: 爷爷看报纸的时候要戴老花镜。
py: yé ye kàn bào zhǐ de shí hou yào dài lǎo huā jìng
en: Grandpa has to wear his reading glasses when he reads the newspaper.
why: Glasses are put on the face, so 戴. 穿 is only for clothes and shoes, and 系 is for things you tie.

s: 我们周末骑地铁去市中心。
s_py: wǒ men zhōu mò qí dì tiě qù shì zhōng xīn
zh: 我们周末坐地铁去市中心。
py: wǒ men zhōu mò zuò dì tiě qù shì zhōng xīn
en: At the weekend we take the subway into the city centre.
why: Passengers sit inside a subway, so 坐. 骑 is only for things you straddle, such as bikes and horses.

q: 下雨了，别骑自行车了，我们___地铁去吧。
zh: 下雨了，别骑自行车了，我们坐地铁去吧。
py: xià yǔ le bié qí zì xíng chē le wǒ men zuò dì tiě qù ba
en: It's raining, so let's not cycle; let's take the subway.
why: Passengers take a subway with 坐. 骑 is for bikes and horses, 开 is for the driver, and 打 does not go with 地铁.

q: 今天是爷爷七十岁的生日，全家人都来给他___生日。
zh: 今天是爷爷七十岁的生日，全家人都来给他过生日。
py: jīn tiān shì yé ye qī shí suì de shēng rì quán jiā rén dōu lái gěi tā guò shēng rì
en: Today is Grandpa's seventieth birthday and the whole family came to celebrate with him.
why: A birthday is 'passed': 过生日. 开 and 打 do not combine with 生日.

q: 今年冬天特别冷，上个星期___了一场大雪。
zh: 今年冬天特别冷，上个星期下了一场大雪。
py: jīn nián dōng tiān tè bié lěng shàng gè xīng qī xià le yī chǎng dà xuě
en: This winter is especially cold; last week there was a heavy snowfall.
why: A snowfall is 下雪, counted with 一场. 打 and 发 do not combine with 雪.

s: 弟弟每天晚上都读电视到很晚。
s_py: dì di měi tiān wǎn shang dōu dú diàn shì dào hěn wǎn
zh: 弟弟每天晚上都看电视到很晚。
py: dì di měi tiān wǎn shang dōu kàn diàn shì dào hěn wǎn
en: My younger brother watches TV until late every evening.
why: TV is watched, so 看电视. 读 is for reading text.

q: 孩子们在海边___了很多照片，笑得很开心。
zh: 孩子们在海边拍了很多照片，笑得很开心。
py: hái zi men zài hǎi biān pāi le hěn duō zhào piàn xiào de hěn kāi xīn
en: The children took lots of photos at the seaside and laughed happily.
why: Photos are taken with 拍 (or 照). English 'take' does not carry over: 拿 means to pick up or hold, and 做 and 打 do not fit 照片.

q: 奶奶年轻的时候会___钢琴，现在手指不灵活了。
zh: 奶奶年轻的时候会弹钢琴，现在手指不灵活了。
py: nǎi nai nián qīng de shí hou huì tán gāng qín xiàn zài shǒu zhǐ bù líng huó le
en: Grandma could play the piano when she was young, but her fingers are stiff now.
why: Piano keys are pressed, so it is 弹钢琴. 打钢琴 is a slip from English 'play'; 拉 is only for the violin and 吹 for wind instruments.

q: 外面雨很大，你出门记得___伞。
zh: 外面雨很大，你出门记得打伞。
py: wài miàn yǔ hěn dà nǐ chū mén jì de dǎ sǎn
en: It's raining hard outside; remember to put up an umbrella when you go out.
why: An umbrella is held up with 打: 打伞. 穿 is for clothes, 戴 for hats and glasses, and 系 for things you tie, so none of them fits 伞.

q: 我把时间___错了，所以今天迟到了二十分钟。
zh: 我把时间搞错了，所以今天迟到了二十分钟。
py: wǒ bǎ shí jiān gǎo cuò le suǒ yǐ jīn tiān chí dào le èr shí fēn zhōng
en: I got the time wrong, so I was twenty minutes late today.
why: 搞错 is the casual spoken 'get it wrong, mess up'. 办 is for formalities, and 发 and 开 do not make 'get the time wrong'.

q: 爸爸和爷爷在客厅里___棋，我在旁边看。
zh: 爸爸和爷爷在客厅里下棋，我在旁边看。
py: bà ba hé yé ye zài kè tīng lǐ xià qí wǒ zài páng biān kàn
en: Dad and Grandpa are playing chess in the living room while I watch.
why: Chess pieces are put down, so the verb is 下: 下棋. 打 does not go with 棋, and 弹 and 拉 are for instruments.

q: 外面___雪了，明天可以和孩子们堆雪人了。
zh: 外面下雪了，明天可以和孩子们堆雪人了。
py: wài miàn xià xuě le míng tiān kě yǐ hé hái zi men duī xuě rén le
en: It's snowing outside; tomorrow we can build a snowman with the kids.
why: Snow and rain 'come down', so 下雪. 雪 is a noun, so 是 or 在 directly before it is wrong, and there is no 'it' subject in Chinese weather.

q: 周末妈妈在厨房里___饭，我在旁边帮忙。
zh: 周末妈妈在厨房里做饭，我在旁边帮忙。
py: zhōu mò mā ma zài chú fáng lǐ zuò fàn wǒ zài páng biān bāng máng
en: At weekends Mum cooks in the kitchen and I help.
why: Cooking a meal is 做饭. 办 is for formalities and errands, and 发 is for sending.

s: 孩子每天晚上洗牙，所以牙齿很白。
s_py: hái zi měi tiān wǎn shang xǐ yá suǒ yǐ yá chǐ hěn bái
zh: 孩子每天晚上刷牙，所以牙齿很白。
py: hái zi měi tiān wǎn shang shuā yá suǒ yǐ yá chǐ hěn bái
en: The child brushes his teeth every night, so his teeth are very white.
why: Daily teeth cleaning is 刷牙. 洗牙 is a professional cleaning at the dentist's.

q: 他昨天淋了雨，今天就___病了。
zh: 他昨天淋了雨，今天就生病了。
py: tā zuó tiān lín le yǔ jīn tiān jiù shēng bìng le
en: He got soaked in the rain yesterday and is ill today.
why: Falling ill is 生病. 起 and 留 do not take 病, and 取 is for withdrawing or collecting.

q: 电脑坏了，我们一起想办法把这个问题___吧。
zh: 电脑坏了，我们一起想办法把这个问题解决吧。
py: diàn nǎo huài le wǒ men yī qǐ xiǎng bàn fǎ bǎ zhè ge wèn tí jiě jué ba
en: The computer is broken; let's find a way to solve this problem together.
why: A problem that must be fixed is 解决. 想办法 shows it is a problem to solve, not a question to answer (回答) or raise (提).

s: 去中国留学以前，他先去办了签证。
s_py: qù zhōng guó liú xué yǐ qián tā xiān qù bàn le qiān zhèng
zh: 去中国留学以前，他先去办了签证。
py: qù zhōng guó liú xué yǐ qián tā xiān qù bàn le qiān zhèng
en: Before going to study in China, he first went to get a visa.
why: Visas are official formalities, so 办签证 is the standard phrase. 办 is right here even though English says 'get'.

s: 爸爸身体不好，已经不喝烟了。
s_py: bà ba shēn tǐ bù hǎo yǐ jīng bù hē yān le
zh: 爸爸身体不好，已经不抽烟了。
py: bà ba shēn tǐ bù hǎo yǐ jīng bù chōu yān le
en: Dad's health isn't good, so he has stopped smoking.
why: Cigarettes are smoked, so 抽烟. 喝 is for drinks and soup.

q: 国庆节我们去草原___马，玩得很开心。
zh: 国庆节我们去草原骑马，玩得很开心。
py: guó qìng jié wǒ men qù cǎo yuán qí mǎ wán de hěn kāi xīn
en: On National Day we went riding on the grassland and had a great time.
why: You sit astride a horse, so 骑马. 坐 and 乘 are for passengers in vehicles, and 开 is for a driver.

s: 今年夏天我们打算去海边度假。
s_py: jīn nián xià tiān wǒ men dǎ suàn qù hǎi biān dù jià
zh: 今年夏天我们打算去海边度假。
py: jīn nián xià tiān wǒ men dǎ suàn qù hǎi biān dù jià
en: This summer we plan to go on holiday to the seaside.
why: 度假 is the fixed word for spending a holiday away. The verb is 度, so the sentence is correct.

q: 每天晚上睡觉以前，我都要___牙。
zh: 每天晚上睡觉以前，我都要刷牙。
py: měi tiān wǎn shang shuì jiào yǐ qián wǒ dōu yào shuā yá
en: I brush my teeth every night before bed.
why: Teeth are brushed with 刷. 洗牙 is a cleaning at the dentist, not daily brushing, and 梳 is for hair.

q: 暑假我们打算___飞机去上海看奶奶。
zh: 暑假我们打算坐飞机去上海看奶奶。
py: shǔ jià wǒ men dǎ suàn zuò fēi jī qù shàng hǎi kàn nǎi nai
en: In the summer holiday we plan to fly to Shanghai to see Grandma.
why: A passenger 坐s a plane. 开飞机 would mean piloting it, 骑 is for bikes and horses, and 打 does not fit 飞机.

q: 晚上八点，爸爸喜欢坐在沙发上___电视。
zh: 晚上八点，爸爸喜欢坐在沙发上看电视。
py: wǎn shang bā diǎn bà ba xǐ huan zuò zài shā fā shang kàn diàn shì
en: At eight in the evening Dad likes to sit on the sofa and watch TV.
why: TV is watched, so 看电视. 读 and 念 are for reading text, and 听 is for sounds, not pictures.

q: 你别生气，我只是跟你___玩笑。
zh: 你别生气，我只是跟你开玩笑。
py: nǐ bié shēng qì wǒ zhǐ shì gēn nǐ kāi wán xiào
en: Don't be angry; I was only kidding.
why: 开玩笑 is the fixed phrase for kidding or teasing. 讲 and 说 go with 笑话 'a joke', not with 玩笑.

q: 他___了决心，明年一定要考上大学。
zh: 他下了决心，明年一定要考上大学。
py: tā xià le jué xīn míng nián yī dìng yào kǎo shàng dà xué
en: He made up his mind to get into university next year.
why: 下决心 is the fixed phrase for making up one's mind. 做 and 打 do not combine with 决心 (做决定 is a different phrase).

q: 我头疼好几天了，下午要去医院___病。
zh: 我头疼好几天了，下午要去医院看病。
py: wǒ tóu téng hǎo jǐ tiān le xià wǔ yào qù yī yuàn kàn bìng
en: I've had a headache for days, so this afternoon I'm going to the hospital to see a doctor.
why: Going to a doctor is 看病. 吃 is for taking medicine, 读 is for reading aloud or studying, and 做 does not fit 病.

s: 这双鞋是新的，我今天第一次戴。
s_py: zhè shuāng xié shì xīn de wǒ jīn tiān dì yī cì dài
zh: 这双鞋是新的，我今天第一次穿。
py: zhè shuāng xié shì xīn de wǒ jīn tiān dì yī cì chuān
en: These shoes are new; today is the first time I'm wearing them.
why: Shoes are things you get into, so 穿. 戴 is for hats, glasses, watches and masks.

q: 我家离学校很近，我每天___自行车去上课。
zh: 我家离学校很近，我每天骑自行车去上课。
py: wǒ jiā lí xué xiào hěn jìn wǒ měi tiān qí zì xíng chē qù shàng kè
en: My home is close to school, so I ride my bike to class every day.
why: You sit astride a bike, so 骑. 开 is for vehicles you drive from a seat, such as cars and buses.

q: 公司下午三点要___会，大家别迟到。
zh: 公司下午三点要开会，大家别迟到。
py: gōng sī xià wǔ sān diǎn yào kāi huì dà jiā bié chí dào
en: The company has a meeting at three this afternoon; don't be late.
why: A meeting is held with 开: 开会. 做 and 打 do not combine with 会, and 看 is for looking.

q: 小弟弟发烧了，医生给他___了一针。
zh: 小弟弟发烧了，医生给他打了一针。
py: xiǎo dì di fā shāo le yī shēng gěi tā dǎ le yī zhēn
en: Little brother had a fever, so the doctor gave him an injection.
why: An injection is 打针, the same verb for giving and having one. 发 goes with 烧 and 邮件, 吃 with pills, and 看 with seeing a doctor.

q: 周末不上班，我们都七点才___床。
zh: 周末不上班，我们都七点才起床。
py: zhōu mò bù shàng bān wǒ men dōu qī diǎn cái qǐ chuáng
en: We don't work at weekends, so we only get up at seven.
why: Getting out of bed is 起床. 站 is for standing up, 上床 means to get into bed, and 取 is for collecting.

q: 天气冷了，妈妈给孩子___了一件厚毛衣。
zh: 天气冷了，妈妈给孩子穿了一件厚毛衣。
py: tiān qì lěng le mā ma gěi hái zi chuān le yī jiàn hòu máo yī
en: It has turned cold, so Mum put a thick sweater on the child.
why: A sweater is something you get into, so 穿. 戴 is for hats, glasses and watches, 系 for ties and belts, and 打 does not take clothes.

s: 奶奶看书的时候穿着眼镜。
s_py: nǎi nai kàn shū de shí hou chuān zhe yǎn jìng
zh: 奶奶看书的时候戴着眼镜。
py: nǎi nai kàn shū de shí hou dài zhe yǎn jìng
en: Grandma wears glasses when she reads.
why: Glasses are put on, so 戴. 穿 is only for clothes and shoes.

q: 这件衣服颜色太___了，我想换一件浅一点儿的。
zh: 这件衣服颜色太深了，我想换一件浅一点儿的。
py: zhè jiàn yī fu yán sè tài shēn le wǒ xiǎng huàn yī jiàn qiǎn yī diǎn r de
en: The colour of this garment is too dark; I'd like to swap it for a lighter one.
why: Dark colours are 深 and light ones 浅, and 浅 later in the sentence confirms the pair. 重, 大 and 强 do not describe colour.

q: 我昨天给你___了一封邮件，你收到了吗？
zh: 我昨天给你发了一封邮件，你收到了吗？
py: wǒ zuó tiān gěi nǐ fā le yī fēng yóu jiàn nǐ shōu dào le ma
en: I sent you an email yesterday. Did you get it?
why: Electronic mail is sent with 发. 送 is for gifts and deliveries, and 提 and 问 are for questions.

q: 我晚上常常___网跟朋友聊天。
zh: 我晚上常常上网跟朋友聊天。
py: wǒ wǎn shang cháng cháng shàng wǎng gēn péng you liáo tiān
en: In the evening I often go online to chat with friends.
why: Going online is 上网. 下 means to leave or finish, and 打 and 开 do not combine with 网.

s: 老师，我可以问你一个问题吗？
s_py: lǎo shī wǒ kě yǐ wèn nǐ yī gè wèn tí ma
zh: 老师，我可以问你一个问题吗？
py: lǎo shī wǒ kě yǐ wèn nǐ yī gè wèn tí ma
en: Teacher, may I ask you a question?
why: Asking a person is 问 + person + 问题, a perfectly normal pattern. 提问题 is also possible, but 问 is not wrong.

s: 我刚才给你寄了一条短信，你看到了吗？
s_py: wǒ gāng cái gěi nǐ jì le yī tiáo duǎn xìn nǐ kàn dào le ma
zh: 我刚才给你发了一条短信，你看到了吗？
py: wǒ gāng cái gěi nǐ fā le yī tiáo duǎn xìn nǐ kàn dào le ma
en: I just sent you a text message; did you see it?
why: Texts are electronic, so 发. 寄 is only for things that go through the post.

q: 她每天早上都花十分钟___头发。
zh: 她每天早上都花十分钟梳头发。
py: tā měi tiān zǎo shang dōu huā shí fēn zhōng shū tóu fa
en: She spends ten minutes combing her hair every morning.
why: Hair is combed with 梳. 刷 is for teeth and shoes, and 穿 and 戴 are for clothes and accessories.

q: 爷爷喜欢喝很___的茶，所以晚上常常睡不着。
zh: 爷爷喜欢喝很浓的茶，所以晚上常常睡不着。
py: yé ye xǐ huan hē hěn nóng de chá suǒ yǐ wǎn shang cháng cháng shuì bù zháo
en: Grandpa likes very strong tea, so he often can't sleep at night.
why: Tea that is strong in taste is 浓. 强 describes power or ability, never a drink, and 重 and 深 do not describe tea.

q: 孩子昨天晚上突然___烧了，三十九度，我们马上去了医院。
zh: 孩子昨天晚上突然发烧了，三十九度，我们马上去了医院。
py: hái zi zuó tiān wǎn shang tū rán fā shāo le sān shí jiǔ dù wǒ men mǎ shàng qù le yī yuàn
en: The child suddenly ran a fever last night, thirty-nine degrees, so we went to the hospital straight away.
why: A fever is 发烧. 生烧 is not a word, though 生病 is, and 起 and 送 do not fit 烧.

q: 我昨天晚上___了一个很长的梦，梦见了小时候的家。
zh: 我昨天晚上做了一个很长的梦，梦见了小时候的家。
py: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shang zuò le yī gè hěn cháng de mèng mèng jiàn le xiǎo shí hou de jiā
en: Last night I had a very long dream; I dreamed of my childhood home.
why: A dream is 'made' in Chinese: 做梦. English 'have a dream' does not carry over, and 看, 说 and 睡 do not take 梦 this way.

q: 今天空气不好，出门别忘了___口罩。
zh: 今天空气不好，出门别忘了戴口罩。
py: jīn tiān kōng qì bù hǎo chū mén bié wàng le dài kǒu zhào
en: The air is bad today; don't forget to wear a mask when you go out.
why: Masks, hats and glasses are put on, so 戴. 穿 is for clothes and shoes, and 系 is for ties and belts.

q: 我身上没有现金了，得去银行___钱。
zh: 我身上没有现金了，得去银行取钱。
py: wǒ shēn shang méi yǒu xiàn jīn le děi qù yín háng qǔ qián
en: I have no cash on me; I have to go to the bank to take out some money.
why: Withdrawing money is 取钱. 起 is for getting up and giving names, 留 is for leaving, and 生 is for giving birth or falling ill.

q: 这杯咖啡太___了，我喝不习惯，请再加点儿水。
zh: 这杯咖啡太浓了，我喝不习惯，请再加点儿水。
py: zhè bēi kā fēi tài nóng le wǒ hē bù xí guàn qǐng zài jiā diǎn r shuǐ
en: This coffee is too strong for me; please add a little more water.
why: Strong coffee is 浓, and asking for more water shows it needs diluting. 淡 means weak and would not need water; 强 and 深 do not describe a drink.

s: 今天是星期天，所以我不用上班。
s_py: jīn tiān shì xīng qī tiān suǒ yǐ wǒ bù yòng shàng bān
zh: 今天是星期天，所以我不用上班。
py: jīn tiān shì xīng qī tiān suǒ yǐ wǒ bù yòng shàng bān
en: It's Sunday, so I don't have to go to work.
why: 上班 is the fixed phrase for going to work and is simply negated with 不用. Nothing needs 去 or 到.

s: 妹妹从五岁开始拉小提琴，现在拉得很好。
s_py: mèi mei cóng wǔ suì kāi shǐ lā xiǎo tí qín xiàn zài lā de hěn hǎo
zh: 妹妹从五岁开始拉小提琴，现在拉得很好。
py: mèi mei cóng wǔ suì kāi shǐ lā xiǎo tí qín xiàn zài lā de hěn hǎo
en: My younger sister has played the violin since she was five and plays very well now.
why: The violin is bowed, so 拉小提琴 is right. 弹小提琴 would be the wrong verb.

q: 同学们约好星期六下午去学校操场___篮球，然后一起去吃饭。
zh: 同学们约好星期六下午去学校操场打篮球，然后一起去吃饭。
py: tóng xué men yuē hǎo xīng qī liù xià wǔ qù xué xiào cāo chǎng dǎ lán qiú rán hòu yī qǐ qù chī fàn
en: The classmates agreed to play basketball on the school field on Saturday afternoon and then eat together.
why: Basketball is played with the hands, so it takes 打, not 踢. 弹 and 下 belong to instruments and chess.

s: 他的病很大，已经住院两个星期了。
s_py: tā de bìng hěn dà yǐ jīng zhù yuàn liǎng gè xīng qī le
zh: 他的病很重，已经住院两个星期了。
py: tā de bìng hěn zhòng yǐ jīng zhù yuàn liǎng gè xīng qī le
en: He is seriously ill and has been in hospital for two weeks.
why: A serious illness is 重. 大 is the English 'big' and does not describe illness.

q: 姐姐每天晚上在房间里___小提琴，声音很好听。
zh: 姐姐每天晚上在房间里拉小提琴，声音很好听。
py: jiě jie měi tiān wǎn shang zài fáng jiān lǐ lā xiǎo tí qín shēng yīn hěn hǎo tīng
en: My older sister plays the violin in her room every evening; it sounds lovely.
why: The violin is bowed, so it takes 拉. 弹 is for piano and guitar, 吹 for wind instruments, and 打 for ball games.

q: 暑假我们去海边___了一个星期的假。
zh: 暑假我们去海边度了一个星期的假。
py: shǔ jià wǒ men qù hǎi biān dù le yī gè xīng qī de jià
en: In the summer holiday we spent a week's holiday at the seaside.
why: 度假 is 'spend a holiday'. 打, 发 and 开 do not combine with 假.

q: 爷爷以前每天要___一包烟，现在为了健康，一根也不碰了。
zh: 爷爷以前每天要抽一包烟，现在为了健康，一根也不碰了。
py: yé ye yǐ qián měi tiān yào chōu yī bāo yān xiàn zài wèi le jiàn kāng yī gēn yě bù pèng le
en: Grandpa used to smoke a pack a day, but for his health he doesn't touch a single one now.
why: Cigarettes are smoked with 抽: 抽烟. 喝烟 is a slip from drinking verbs, and 看 and 读 are for the eyes.

q: 上课的时候，你有不明白的地方可以随时向老师___问题。
zh: 上课的时候，你有不明白的地方可以随时向老师提问题。
py: shàng kè de shí hou nǐ yǒu bù míng bai de dì fang kě yǐ suí shí xiàng lǎo shī tí wèn tí
en: In class, if there's something you don't understand you can raise a question with the teacher at any time.
why: Raising a question is 提问题. 回答 is for answering one and 解决 is for solving a problem.

q: 我的朋友打算明年去英国___学。
zh: 我的朋友打算明年去英国留学。
py: wǒ de péng you dǎ suàn míng nián qù yīng guó liú xué
en: My friend plans to study in Britain next year.
why: Studying abroad is 留学. 读 takes 大学 or 书 but does not form a word with 学, and 取 does not fit.

q: 我弟弟每个周末都去公园___足球。
zh: 我弟弟每个周末都去公园踢足球。
py: wǒ dì di měi gè zhōu mò dōu qù gōng yuán tī zú qiú
en: My younger brother goes to the park to play football every weekend.
why: Football is kicked, so it takes 踢. 打 is for hand or racket ball games such as 篮球 and 网球; 弹 is for keys and strings, and 下 is for chess.

q: 这部电影是一位年轻的导演___的，花了整整两年才完成。
zh: 这部电影是一位年轻的导演拍的，花了整整两年才完成。
py: zhè bù diàn yǐng shì yī wèi nián qīng de dǎo yǎn pāi de huā le zhěng zhěng liǎng nián cái wán chéng
en: This film was shot by a young director and took a full two years to finish.
why: Films are shot with 拍. 照电影 is a slip from English 'shoot', and 拿 and 打 do not fit 电影.

q: 明天放假，可是老师还是给我们___了两页作业。
zh: 明天放假，可是老师还是给我们留了两页作业。
py: míng tiān fàng jià kě shì lǎo shī hái shi gěi wǒ men liú le liǎng yè zuò yè
en: Tomorrow is a holiday, but the teacher still set us two pages of homework.
why: Setting homework is 留作业: the teacher 'leaves' it for you. 送 is for gifts, 提 is for raising points, and 取 is for collecting.

s: 我哥哥喜欢打足球，每个周末都去。
s_py: wǒ gē ge xǐ huan dǎ zú qiú měi gè zhōu mò dōu qù
zh: 我哥哥喜欢踢足球，每个周末都去。
py: wǒ gē ge xǐ huan tī zú qiú měi gè zhōu mò dōu qù
en: My older brother likes playing football and goes every weekend.
why: Football is kicked, so it is 踢足球. 打 is for hand and racket ball games such as 篮球.

q: 公司每个月十号给我们___工资。
zh: 公司每个月十号给我们发工资。
py: gōng sī měi gè yuè shí hào gěi wǒ men fā gōng zī
en: The company pays us on the tenth of every month.
why: Paying wages is 发工资. 寄 is only for things that go through the post, and 送 is for gifts.

s: 昨天晚上我办了一个很奇怪的梦。
s_py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ bàn le yī gè hěn qí guài de mèng
zh: 昨天晚上我做了一个很奇怪的梦。
py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ zuò le yī gè hěn qí guài de mèng
en: Last night I had a very strange dream.
why: A dream is 'made': 做梦. 办 is for formalities and errands.

q: 奶奶的病很___，医生说要住院一个月。
zh: 奶奶的病很重，医生说要住院一个月。
py: nǎi nai de bìng hěn zhòng yī shēng shuō yào zhù yuàn yī gè yuè
en: Grandma is seriously ill; the doctor says she must stay in hospital for a month.
why: A serious illness is 重 (a mild one is 轻). 大 is the tempting 'big', but 病 does not take it as a predicate.

s: 爸爸妈妈给小宝宝起了一个很好听的名字。
s_py: bà ba mā ma gěi xiǎo bǎo bao qǐ le yī gè hěn hǎo tīng de míng zi
zh: 爸爸妈妈给小宝宝起了一个很好听的名字。
py: bà ba mā ma gěi xiǎo bǎo bao qǐ le yī gè hěn hǎo tīng de míng zi
en: Mum and Dad gave the baby a lovely name.
why: 起名字 is the normal phrase for naming someone (取名字 works too). 起 here is not 'rise', so the sentence is correct.

q: 开车的时候一定要___好安全带。
zh: 开车的时候一定要系好安全带。
py: kāi chē de shí hou yī dìng yào jì hǎo ān quán dài
en: You must fasten your seat belt when you drive.
why: A seat belt is fastened like a tie, with 系 (read jì). 穿 is for clothes, and 戴 and 打 are not used with 安全带.

s: 参加面试的时候，他系了一条蓝色的领带。
s_py: cān jiā miàn shì de shí hou tā jì le yī tiáo lán sè de lǐng dài
zh: 参加面试的时候，他系了一条蓝色的领带。
py: cān jiā miàn shì de shí hou tā jì le yī tiáo lán sè de lǐng dài
en: He wore a blue tie to the job interview.
why: A tie is tied, so 系 (jì) is right. 穿领带 would be wrong, because 穿 is for clothes you get into.

s: 我每天晚上八点以后才办作业。
s_py: wǒ měi tiān wǎn shang bā diǎn yǐ hòu cái bàn zuò yè
zh: 我每天晚上八点以后才做作业。
py: wǒ měi tiān wǎn shang bā diǎn yǐ hòu cái zuò zuò yè
en: I don't do my homework until after eight every evening.
why: Homework is done with 做. 办 is for formalities and errands, like 办手续.

q: 外面下雪了，你要___上帽子和手套，别把耳朵冻坏了。
zh: 外面下雪了，你要戴上帽子和手套，别把耳朵冻坏了。
py: wài miàn xià xuě le nǐ yào dài shàng mào zi hé shǒu tào bié bǎ ěr duo dòng huài le
en: It's snowing outside; put on a hat and gloves so your ears don't freeze.
why: Hats and gloves are put on, so 戴. 穿 is for things you get into, like coats and boots, and 系 is for things you tie.

s: 弟弟每天九点钟去班，六点才回家。
s_py: dì di měi tiān jiǔ diǎn zhōng qù bān liù diǎn cái huí jiā
zh: 弟弟每天九点钟上班，六点才回家。
py: dì di měi tiān jiǔ diǎn zhōng shàng bān liù diǎn cái huí jiā
en: My younger brother starts work at nine every day and only gets home at six.
why: Going to work is 上班; 班 on its own is a shift or a class, so 去班 is not a phrase.

q: 她手腕上___着一块很漂亮的手表。
zh: 她手腕上戴着一块很漂亮的手表。
py: tā shǒu wàn shang dài zhe yī kuài hěn piào liang de shǒu biǎo
en: She has a very pretty watch on her wrist.
why: A watch is worn, so 戴. 穿 is for clothes, and 拿着 would mean she is holding it in her hand, which 手腕上 'on the wrist' rules out.

s: 我去银行起钱，顺便把信寄了。
s_py: wǒ qù yín háng qǐ qián shùn biàn bǎ xìn jì le
zh: 我去银行取钱，顺便把信寄了。
py: wǒ qù yín háng qǔ qián shùn biàn bǎ xìn jì le
en: I went to the bank to withdraw some money and posted a letter on the way.
why: Withdrawing money is 取钱. 起 is for getting up and naming.

s: 外面下着大雨，我们打车去朋友家吧。
s_py: wài miàn xià zhe dà yǔ wǒ men dǎ chē qù péng you jiā ba
zh: 外面下着大雨，我们打车去朋友家吧。
py: wài miàn xià zhe dà yǔ wǒ men dǎ chē qù péng you jiā ba
en: It's pouring outside; let's take a taxi to my friend's place.
why: 打车 is the normal way to say 'take a taxi' (hail one). 打 has nothing to do with hitting here, so the sentence is correct.

q: 弟弟打碎了杯子，妈妈很___气，说了他几句。
zh: 弟弟打碎了杯子，妈妈很生气，说了他几句。
py: dì di dǎ suì le bēi zi mā ma hěn shēng qì shuō le tā jǐ jù
en: My little brother broke a glass, and Mum was angry and scolded him.
why: Getting angry is 生气. 起, 留 and 取 do not combine with 气.

q: 邻居敲门，给我们___来一些自己种的菜。
zh: 邻居敲门，给我们送来一些自己种的菜。
py: lín jū qiāo mén gěi wǒ men sòng lái yī xiē zì jǐ zhòng de cài
en: A neighbour knocked and brought us some vegetables he had grown himself.
why: Bringing something to a door as a gift is 送. 寄 would mean it came by post, which 敲门 rules out, and 发 and 问 do not fit.

s: 外面在雨，你出门要带伞。
s_py: wài miàn zài yǔ nǐ chū mén yào dài sǎn
zh: 外面在下雨，你出门要带伞。
py: wài miàn zài xià yǔ nǐ chū mén yào dài sǎn
en: It's raining outside, so take an umbrella when you go out.
why: 雨 is a noun, so rain needs the verb 下 'fall': 在下雨.

s: 昨天晚上雨下得特别大，早上路上还有很多水。
s_py: zuó tiān wǎn shang yǔ xià de tè bié dà zǎo shang lù shang hái yǒu hěn duō shuǐ
zh: 昨天晚上雨下得特别大，早上路上还有很多水。
py: zuó tiān wǎn shang yǔ xià de tè bié dà zǎo shang lù shang hái yǒu hěn duō shuǐ
en: It rained very hard last night, and this morning there was still a lot of water on the road.
why: Heavy rain is 雨下得很大. 大 is the right word for rain, not 重 or 强.

q: 你找小王吗？他不在，你可以给他___言，请他回来以后给你回电话。
zh: 你找小王吗？他不在，你可以给他留言，请他回来以后给你回电话。
py: nǐ zhǎo xiǎo wáng ma tā bù zài nǐ kě yǐ gěi tā liú yán qǐng tā huí lái yǐ hòu gěi nǐ huí diàn huà
en: Are you looking for Xiao Wang? He's out; you can leave him a message and ask him to call you back.
why: A message left for someone is 留言. 取 is for collecting, 起 is for getting up, and 生 does not fit 言.

q: 妈妈晚上六点___班回来，顺便在超市买了菜。
zh: 妈妈晚上六点下班回来，顺便在超市买了菜。
py: mā ma wǎn shang liù diǎn xià bān huí lái shùn biàn zài chāo shì mǎi le cài
en: Mum got back from work at six in the evening and bought groceries at the supermarket on the way.
why: Finishing work is 下班, which fits coming home in the evening. 上班 is starting work, and 去班 and 做班 are not phrases.

s: 我叔叔会开飞机，他是飞行员。
s_py: wǒ shū shu huì kāi fēi jī tā shì fēi xíng yuán
zh: 我叔叔会开飞机，他是飞行员。
py: wǒ shū shu huì kāi fēi jī tā shì fēi xíng yuán
en: My uncle can fly planes; he's a pilot.
why: A pilot is the driver of the plane, so 开飞机 is right. 坐飞机 would make him only a passenger.

q: 妈妈每个周末都给奶奶___电话。
zh: 妈妈每个周末都给奶奶打电话。
py: mā ma měi gè zhōu mò dōu gěi nǎi nai dǎ diàn huà
en: Mum phones Grandma every weekend.
why: A phone call is made with 打: 给 + person + 打电话. 发 is for texts and emails, and 说 and 做 cannot take 电话 as an object.

s: 我每天早上六点钟取床，然后去跑步。
s_py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang liù diǎn zhōng qǔ chuáng rán hòu qù pǎo bù
zh: 我每天早上六点钟起床，然后去跑步。
py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang liù diǎn zhōng qǐ chuáng rán hòu qù pǎo bù
en: I get up at six every morning and then go running.
why: Getting up is 起床. 取 means to collect or withdraw.

q: 昨天夜里风很___，窗户都被吹开了。
zh: 昨天夜里风很大，窗户都被吹开了。
py: zuó tiān yè lǐ fēng hěn dà chuāng hu dōu bèi chuī kāi le
en: The wind was very strong last night and blew all the windows open.
why: Wind is 大 or 小. 重, 深 and 多 do not describe wind.

s: 这杯咖啡太强了，我晚上喝了会睡不着。
s_py: zhè bēi kā fēi tài qiáng le wǒ wǎn shang hē le huì shuì bù zháo
zh: 这杯咖啡太浓了，我晚上喝了会睡不着。
py: zhè bēi kā fēi tài nóng le wǒ wǎn shang hē le huì shuì bù zháo
en: This coffee is too strong; if I drink it in the evening I won't be able to sleep.
why: Strong coffee is 浓. 强 describes power or ability, never a drink.

q: 他今年在北京___大学，学的是历史。
zh: 他今年在北京读大学，学的是历史。
py: tā jīn nián zài běi jīng dú dà xué xué de shì lì shǐ
en: This year he is studying at a university in Beijing, majoring in history.
why: 读大学 means to study at university. 看 means to look at something and 吃 is only for eating, so neither can describe studying.

q: 叔叔在上海___生意，一年只回家一两次。
zh: 叔叔在上海做生意，一年只回家一两次。
py: shū shu zài shàng hǎi zuò shēng yi yī nián zhǐ huí jiā yī liǎng cì
en: My uncle does business in Shanghai and only comes home once or twice a year.
why: Doing business is 做生意. 办 is for formalities and errands, and 开 and 发 do not combine with 生意.

q: 春节我们一家人要回奶奶家___年。
zh: 春节我们一家人要回奶奶家过年。
py: chūn jié wǒ men yī jiā rén yào huí nǎi nai jiā guò nián
en: At Spring Festival our whole family goes to Grandma's to celebrate the New Year.
why: 过年 is the fixed phrase for celebrating the New Year. 开 and 打 do not fit 年, and 看 is for seeing.

q: 孩子们放学回家，先___作业，然后才能玩。
zh: 孩子们放学回家，先做作业，然后才能玩。
py: hái zi men fàng xué huí jiā xiān zuò zuò yè rán hòu cái néng wán
en: When the children get home from school they do their homework first and only then can they play.
why: Homework is done with 做: 做作业. 办 is for paperwork and 发 is for sending.

q: 老师让我们大声___课文，不要小声说话。
zh: 老师让我们大声读课文，不要小声说话。
py: lǎo shī ràng wǒ men dà shēng dú kè wén bù yào xiǎo shēng shuō huà
en: The teacher told us to read the text aloud and not to mumble.
why: Reading aloud is 读 (or 念), and 大声 'loudly' shows it is aloud. 看 is silent looking, and 吃 and 抽 are mouth verbs for food and cigarettes.

s: 爸爸教我开自行车，现在我已经学会了。
s_py: bà ba jiāo wǒ kāi zì xíng chē xiàn zài wǒ yǐ jīng xué huì le
zh: 爸爸教我骑自行车，现在我已经学会了。
py: bà ba jiāo wǒ qí zì xíng chē xiàn zài wǒ yǐ jīng xué huì le
en: Dad taught me to ride a bike, and now I've learned.
why: You sit astride a bike, so 骑. 开 is for vehicles you drive from a seat, such as cars and buses.

s: 我们在公园里拿了很多照片，真漂亮。
s_py: wǒ men zài gōng yuán lǐ ná le hěn duō zhào piàn zhēn piào liang
zh: 我们在公园里拍了很多照片，真漂亮。
py: wǒ men zài gōng yuán lǐ pāi le hěn duō zhào piàn zhēn piào liang
en: We took lots of photos in the park, and they look lovely.
why: Taking photos is 拍 (or 照). 拿 means to pick up or hold, so it cannot describe taking pictures.

s: 她正在房间里读小说，没有听见我们说话。
s_py: tā zhèng zài fáng jiān lǐ dú xiǎo shuō méi yǒu tīng jiàn wǒ men shuō huà
zh: 她正在房间里读小说，没有听见我们说话。
py: tā zhèng zài fáng jiān lǐ dú xiǎo shuō méi yǒu tīng jiàn wǒ men shuō huà
en: She's reading a novel in her room and didn't hear us talking.
why: 读 is not limited to reading aloud: 读小说 is a normal way to say reading a novel silently. 看小说 would be right too.

q: 老师问我昨天去哪儿了，我不好意思___这个问题。
zh: 老师问我昨天去哪儿了，我不好意思回答这个问题。
py: lǎo shī wèn wǒ zuó tiān qù nǎ r le wǒ bù hǎo yì si huí dá zhè ge wèn tí
en: The teacher asked where I was yesterday, and I was too embarrassed to answer.
why: A question put to you is answered with 回答. 解决 is for solving a problem, and 提 raises one.

q: 外面的雨下得很___，你等雨小一点儿再走吧。
zh: 外面的雨下得很大，你等雨小一点儿再走吧。
py: wài miàn de yǔ xià de hěn dà nǐ děng yǔ xiǎo yī diǎn r zài zǒu ba
en: It's raining hard outside; wait until it eases before you leave.
why: Heavy rain is 下得很大, light rain 下得很小. 重 and 强 are tempting from 'heavy' and 'strong', but rain is not described with them.

q: 他说话声音很___，我坐在后面一点儿也听不见。
zh: 他说话声音很小，我坐在后面一点儿也听不见。
py: tā shuō huà shēng yīn hěn xiǎo wǒ zuò zài hòu miàn yī diǎn r yě tīng bù jiàn
en: He speaks so quietly that I can't hear him at all from the back.
why: A quiet voice is 小 (a loud one is 大). 少 is for amounts, 短 is for length, and 浅 is for colour or depth.

q: 那次旅行给我留下了很___的印象，我到现在还记得。
zh: 那次旅行给我留下了很深的印象，我到现在还记得。
py: nà cì lǚ xíng gěi wǒ liú xià le hěn shēn de yìn xiàng wǒ dào xiàn zài hái jì de
en: That trip left a deep impression on me, and I still remember it.
why: A strong impression is 深. 大 'big' and 重 'heavy' are word-for-word guesses that do not collocate with 印象.

q: 我今天要去银行___手续，下午才能回家。
zh: 我今天要去银行办手续，下午才能回家。
py: wǒ jīn tiān yào qù yín háng bàn shǒu xù xià wǔ cái néng huí jiā
en: I have to go to the bank today to sort out some paperwork and won't be home until the afternoon.
why: Formalities and paperwork are handled with 办: 办手续. 做 is for cooking, homework and dreams, and 发 is for sending.

q: 顾客对服务不太满意，向经理___了很多意见。
zh: 顾客对服务不太满意，向经理提了很多意见。
py: gù kè duì fú wù bù tài mǎn yì xiàng jīng lǐ tí le hěn duō yì jiàn
en: The customer was not very happy with the service and made a lot of complaints to the manager.
why: Opinions and suggestions are raised, so 提意见. 发, 送 and 寄 are for sending or giving things, not for putting forward opinions.

q: 妈妈做好饭了，快来___饭吧。
zh: 妈妈做好饭了，快来吃饭吧。
py: mā ma zuò hǎo fàn le kuài lái chī fàn ba
en: Mum has finished cooking; come and eat.
why: Food is eaten, so 吃饭. 喝饭 is a slip from the English 'have'; 喝 is for drinks and soup, and 抽 is for cigarettes.

q: 请你把照片用微信___给我，我想给妈妈看。
zh: 请你把照片用微信发给我，我想给妈妈看。
py: qǐng nǐ bǎ zhào piàn yòng wēi xìn fā gěi wǒ wǒ xiǎng gěi mā ma kàn
en: Please send me the photos on WeChat; I want to show Mum.
why: Anything sent electronically is 发. 寄 is only for the post, and 送 is for gifts and deliveries.

q: 弟弟只是摔了一下，伤很___，不用去医院。
zh: 弟弟只是摔了一下，伤很轻，不用去医院。
py: dì di zhǐ shì shuāi le yī xià shāng hěn qīng bù yòng qù yī yuàn
en: My brother only had a little fall; the injury is slight and he doesn't need the hospital.
why: A slight injury is 轻 (a serious one is 重). 低, 少 and 淡 do not describe injuries.

q: 爸爸每天早上七点出门___班，晚上六点才回来。
zh: 爸爸每天早上七点出门上班，晚上六点才回来。
py: bà ba měi tiān zǎo shang qī diǎn chū mén shàng bān wǎn shang liù diǎn cái huí lái
en: Dad leaves for work at seven every morning and only comes back at six in the evening.
why: Going to work is 上班. 下班 is leaving work, and 去班 and 做班 are not phrases.

s: 她给在国外的朋友寄了一封信。
s_py: tā gěi zài guó wài de péng you jì le yī fēng xìn
zh: 她给在国外的朋友寄了一封信。
py: tā gěi zài guó wài de péng you jì le yī fēng xìn
en: She posted a letter to a friend abroad.
why: A letter that travels by post is 寄. 发 would suit an email, but a paper letter is posted.
